# Synthetic toy-memory fixtures

The source CSV and expected TSVs in this directory are deterministically generated by
`ops/scripts/generate_toy_memory_fixtures.py`. All identifiers, dates, task and stimulus
names, timings, conditions, and responses are invented for testing. These files contain
no participant-derived or study-derived data.

The generator intentionally writes identical fixture bytes at the research-bids and
research-neuro package boundaries. Run it without arguments to regenerate the fixtures,
or with `--check` to verify the checked-in files.
